item.title: Bomb hoax emails target thousands of schools in UK and Italy
item.body: The email threats originated from outside the UK. They caused schools to evacuate students and staff.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🚨 Bomb hoax emails target thousands of schools in UK and Italy

The email threats originated from outside the UK. They caused schools to evacuate students and staff.

Source: The Independent | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 11 November, 18:50

#BreakingNews #SchoolSafety #HoaxThreats
